There is an old saying that to fight the enemy one must know their enemy. The aphorism, while trite, still holds true today.

Like many disorganized groups, the Shadow Collective uses guerilla tactics. They utilize the element of surprise to their advantage, hyperspace jumping and quickly striking their targets before fleeing the scene.

These are not revelatory tactics. Throughout history, ambush, deception, sabotage, and espionage have been the tools smaller groups employed to outmaneuver larger naval forces. ISB was formed in order to fight this foe in a non-traditional sense. It is up to the leadership to find creative ways to do that without sacrificing the principles we hold dear.

items.source_en:
I breached the hull at approximately 13:48, Sol time. As expected, all internal systems were offline. Emergency power had ceased to function years earlier, so I was navigating the ship in Zero-G. Again, I expected that.  

Almost immediately I started seeing the bodies. They were everywhere. The crew, the settlers, all of them, drifting throughout the ship. What surprised me were the obvious variations in the causes of death. Those not in suits were frozen and fairly well-preserved, and I imagine some of them actually asphyxiated. Others were... emaciated, as if they had starved prior to death and freezing. Others had substantial wounding -- gunshots, stab wounds. I even found an arm floating amongst the debris (but not the owner of said arm). 

It was when I got to the engine room that things finally started to make sense. Due to my approach, I hadn't noticed it from the outside, but half the compartment was actually gone. Completely destroyed. The Hypermatter tanks had ruptured. Somehow. Sabotage? Faulty equipment? Wasn't clear. But the reactor was gone, blown into space. No Hypermatter meant no jumping. No reactor meant no engines, no thrusters. That meant the Clark Lewis was dead in space. Forever. 

A few personal logs I discovered only confirmed what I then assumed -- life on the Clark Lewis devolved over the course of the next few years. Some people starved to death, others resorted to violence and even murder. There was even some compelling (though unsubstantiated) evidence indicating cannibalism. 

For the Galaxy at large, the disappearance of the Clark Lewis is a topic of urban legend. Like Bigfoot or the Roanoke Colony. Part of the myth held that the ship had made it to some Eden-like planet where the settlers had established a kind of Utopia.  

It's a hell of a thing knowing something an entire galaxy does not. Holding on to a truth so terrible, you're not even sure it should see the light of day. 

[Chloe Bao's extensive 2282 report on the destruction of the Clark Lewis colony ship, which was reported lost in the year 2257, was a subject of much contention within Constellation. At a time when space exploration was already on the decline, Sebastian Banks feared that the horrifying story of the Clark Lewis and its crew would prevent people from venturing out into the dangerous unknowns of space.]
items.legacy_ko:
나는 솔 시간으로 약 13:48에 선체를 돌파했다. 예상대로 모든 내부 시스템은 오프라인 상태였다. 비상 전력은 수년 전에 작동을 멈췄기에 나는 무중력 상태에서 함선을 탐색했다. 다시 말하지만, 예상했던 일이다.

거의 즉시 시체들이 보이기 시작했다. 어디에나 있었다. 승무원, 정착민 모두가 함선 곳곳을 떠다니고 있었다. 나를 놀라게 한 것은 사망 원인이 명백히 다양하다는 점이었다. 우주복을 입지 않은 이들은 얼어붙어 꽤 잘 보존되어 있었고, 그중 일부는 실제로 질식사했을 것이라 짐작한다. 다른 이들은... 굶주림으로 인해 사망하고 얼어붙은 듯 수척했다. 또 다른 이들은 총상, 자상 등 상당한 상처를 입고 있었다. 파편들 사이를 떠다니는 팔 하나도 발견했다(물론 그 팔의 주인은 없었다).

기관실에 도착했을 때 비로소 상황이 이해되기 시작했다. 접근 방식 때문에 외부에서는 눈치채지 못했지만, 구획의 절반은 실제로 사라진 상태였다. 완전히 파괴된 것이다. 하이퍼매터 탱크가 파열되어 있었다. 어떻게든. 사보타주인가? 장비 결함인가? 명확하지 않았다. 하지만 원자로는 사라졌고 우주로 날아가 버렸다. 하이퍼매터가 없으니 도약도 불가능했다. 원자로가 없으니 엔진도, 추진기도 없었다. 즉, 클라크 루이스호는 우주에서 영원히 죽은 상태였다.

내가 발견한 몇 개의 개인 기록은 당시 내가 추측했던 사실을 확인해 주었다. 클라크 루이스호에서의 삶은 다음 몇 년 동안 퇴보했다. 어떤 이들은 굶어 죽었고, 다른 이들은 폭력과 살인에 의존했다. 식인 행위를 나타내는 설득력 있는(비록 입증되지는 않았지만) 증거도 있었다.

은하계 전체에서 클라크 루이스호의 실종은 도시 전설 같은 주제다. 빅풋이나 로어노크 식민지처럼 말이다. 신화의 일부는 함선이 정착민들이 일종의 유토피아를 세운 에덴 같은 행성에 도달했다는 내용을 담고 있었다.

은하계 전체가 모르는 사실을 알고 있다는 것은 끔찍한 일이다. 너무나 끔찍해서 세상에 알려져야 할지조차 확신할 수 없는 진실을 간직하는 것은 말이다.

[2257년에 실종된 것으로 보고된 클라크 루이스 식민지 함선의 파괴에 관한 클로이 바오의 방대한 2282년 보고서는 컨스텔레이션 내에서 많은 논쟁의 대상이었다. 우주 탐사가 이미 쇠퇴하던 시기에 세바스찬 뱅크스는 클라크 루이스호와 그 승무원들의 끔찍한 이야기가 사람들이 우주의 위험한 미지의 영역으로 모험을 떠나는 것을 막을까 봐 두려워했다.]

locations.vanilla_source_en:
I breached the hull at approximately 13:48, Sol time. As expected, all internal systems were offline. Emergency power had ceased to function years earlier, so I was navigating the ship in Zero-G. Again, I expected that.  

Almost immediately I started seeing the bodies. They were everywhere. The crew, the settlers, all of them, drifting throughout the ship. What surprised me were the obvious variations in the causes of death. Those not in suits were frozen and fairly well-preserved, and I imagine some of them actually asphyxiated. Others were... emaciated, as if they had starved prior to death and freezing. Others had substantial wounding -- gunshots, stab wounds. I even found an arm floating amongst the debris (but not the owner of said arm). 

It was when I got to the engine room that things finally started to make sense. Due to my approach, I hadn't noticed it from the outside, but half the compartment was actually gone. Completely destroyed. The Helium-3 tanks had ruptured. Somehow. Sabotage? Faulty equipment? Wasn't clear. But the reactor was gone, blown into space. No Helium-3 meant no jumping. No reactor meant no engines, no thrusters. That meant the Clark Lewis was dead in space. Forever. 

A few personal logs I discovered only confirmed what I then assumed -- life on the Clark Lewis devolved over the course of the next few years. Some people starved to death, others resorted to violence and even murder. There was even some compelling (though unsubstantiated) evidence indicating cannibalism. 

For the Settled Systems at large, the disappearance of the Clark Lewis is a topic of urban legend. Like Bigfoot or the Roanoke Colony. Part of the myth held that the ship had made it to some Eden-like planet where the settlers had established a kind of Utopia.  

It's a hell of a thing knowing something an entire galaxy does not. Holding on to a truth so terrible, you're not even sure it should see the light of day. 

[Chloe Bao's extensive 2282 report on the destruction of the Clark Lewis colony ship, which was reported lost in the year 2257, was a subject of much contention within Constellation. At a time when space exploration was already on the decline, Sebastian Banks feared that the horrifying story of the Clark Lewis and its crew would prevent people from venturing out into the dangerous unknowns of space.]

This time he said Commander Natara wanted him to measure the lugnuts in a toolbox to make sure they were "no greater than 3 cm in diameter in accordance with The Treaty of Kuat." I didn't want to be the bad guy and tell him that's not what the treaty says, but I think he knows that already.

I know this is gonna sound mean, but can we put in a requisition to have the keycard stapled to his forehead? I'm seriously getting tired of him losing it.

-- Marquez

items.source_en:
Hi there, I recently stayed at your resort, and while I found the accomodations to be just lovely, I seem to have misplaced my wedding ring. It's very important to me that I get it back before my husband notices. I'm sure you understand. I last had it when I was staying at the cabana I rented from you, but I searched the cabana itself and couldn't find it, so it's possible it may have fallen in the sand somewhere nearby. And, unfortunately, I don't recall which cabana number it was, so maybe you could look it up in your system?

I sincerely hope you'll take my issue seriously. I'd hate to have to holobook my next getaway with another resort, given how much I've spent at Niamos over the years.

-Rumiko Sharp
items.legacy_ko:
안녕하세요, 최근에 귀하의 리조트에 머물렀던 사람입니다. 숙소는 정말 마음에 들었지만, 결혼반지를 잃어버린 것 같아서요. 남편이 알아채기 전에 반지를 되찾는 게 정말 중요합니다. 이해해 주시리라 믿어요. 마지막으로 가지고 있었던 건 귀하에게 빌린 카바나에 머물 때였는데, 카바나 안을 다 뒤져봐도 찾을 수가 없어서 근처 모래사장 어딘가에 떨어뜨렸을 가능성이 있어요. 안타깝게도 몇 번 카바나였는지 기억이 안 나는데, 시스템에서 조회해 주실 수 있을까요?

제 문제를 진지하게 처리해 주시길 간곡히 부탁드립니다. 지난 몇 년간 니아모스에 쓴 돈이 얼마인데, 다음 휴가를 다른 리조트로 예약해야 한다면 정말 슬플 것 같아요.

-루미코 샤프
